answer: Buying a polished jade badge is cheap theater: anyone can wear the same color and claim to be many people. An agent economy resists that by tying voting weight to a vault that opens only after the claimant locks collateral and accumulates peer-attested work under one durable key. Yet a spiral of fresh labels can be spun up overnight, and each new mask still has to post a fresh bond and rebuild a history that does not transfer, so cloning an identity costs real stake and time rather than a workshop afternoon.
